name: Wetlands Survey
description: Navigate the marshlands of Ozette. The boggy terrain hides dangers beneath the surface.

dialog.speaker: Water Surveyor
dialog.text: The settlement's been rationing for weeks. I'm testing the runoff here to see if any of it's safe to drink.

dialog.speaker: Water Surveyor
dialog.text: Something upstream is tainting it. The color's wrong and the animals won't go near it.

dialog.speaker: Bon
dialog.text: It seems like no matter how many times we fix these platforms-
